text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Neo Universe in town.
She was staring intently at food samples labeled 'Party Platter'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Observation". "Hubble's" 『connection』......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, I was reminded of Kiseki's manga that Victoire Pisa had recommended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If it were her protagonist, she'd probably reach out a helping hand without a second thought.
choice_data_list: ...Hey, by any chance, do you want to throw a party?
...Hey, by any chance, do you want to throw a party?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking that maybe there was something I could do, I opened my phone's messaging app.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
How's this Japanese-style party, huh?!
Taking off our shoes and sitting knee-to-knee is so traditional and cool~♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Sense 『enjoyment』.
Did a lot of "energy replenishment".

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
We've got traditional performance arts coming up soon too~!
I made some new connections at the last party and invited them over today♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Just like Kiseki-san's manga.
People connect, and the circle expands. It's lovely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Universe-san.
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Saw Kiseki's 『manga』.
That is why Neo Universe also wanted to 『connect』.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Can we be like the person in the 『manga』...?
Even when the party ends, will Neo Universe and everyone be... 『besties 4eva』?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...
Universe-san. Um—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Why don't we all play a game of 'Umamusume Knot', like a human knot?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...『Umamusume Knot』?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I used to play it a lot when I was little.
It's kind of like making a wish, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Including myself, we all formed a large circle.
Each person held hands with different people with their left and right hands, and the game of untangling the 'knot' began.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...It untangles surprisingly easily.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Easy stuff.
We could've even raised the difficulty a bit.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't we super emotional right now!?
The muse of creation has descended upon us!!
Um! Why don't we try spinning fast in place right now!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very well.
That too is a trial for a saint.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was that part of the game?
...Well, sounds fun, so let's give it a shot♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, feels like being a kid again after so long.
We used to play games like this, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was close friends, a child sitting alone in the park,
or a group from the next town over... I would expand the circle
and play with everyone, no matter who they were.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And those memories still remain in my heart today.
The bonds we connected have never been broken, even now—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...So, together now?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You are also a precious connection to me,
Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And... one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I brought a present for you.
A handmade accessory.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...For Neo Universe?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Um, I had been concerned about you for a while.
You looked a bit lonely at times...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It was the same when I saw you in town before.
I was about to call out to you, but—

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Voice
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, do you want to have a party?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Voice
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, do you want to have a party?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...There was someone so kind.
Someone who reached out their hand before I could.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I was inspired by such warmth, you see.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san.
Will you accept this?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Of course.
It's "MUTEV"... fufufu.
choice_data_list: I can't beat you at this.
I really can't compete with you.
So handmade crafts are your hobby.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Of course.
It's "MUTEV"... fufufu.
choice_data_list: I can't beat you at this.
I really can't compete with you.
So handmade crafts are your hobby.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
! ...No.
That's my line, you know.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I can make all sorts of things. So please don't hesitate
to ask... you too, Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
! ...No. Next time, I will give "return gift".
"JEM"... keep it safe, okay?
